open_points.subject: import_snapshot
open_points.text: - import_snapshot: [BEHAVIOR] MUST read the current UTC time once per operation, by one call of utc_now, and use that single instant for every timestamp it creates and every current-time comparison it makes; the publication's `approved_at` and `published_at` are copied as published, never replaced by it; it MUST NOT read a host clock itself.
open_points.other_text: def append_audit(repository: AuditRepository, intent: AuditIntent) -> AuditRecord
open_points.question: How can import_snapshot make the appended AuditRecord use the single utc_now instant when append_audit accepts no timestamp argument?
